{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2187381e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Antenna Element"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "efec1d0e",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import scipy.io\n",
    "\n",
    "import neoradium as nr"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "0b128508",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Create an antenna element with a 65° beamwidth and a maximum attenuation of 30 dB.\n",
    "el = nr.AntennaElement(beamWidth=[65,65], maxAttenuation=30)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "1a973b7a",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 600x600 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Depending on the input parameters, the 'drawRadiation' method can generate different types of plots.\n",
    "# Here, we plot the antenna element's directivity in the horizontal plane at zero elevation.\n",
    "ax = el.drawRadiation(theta=90, viewAngles=(90,0), radiationType=\"Directivity\", normalize=True)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "2fa8de96",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 600x600 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Here, the 'drawRadiation' method is used to plot the field values in the vertical plane at an azimuth angle of 0°.\n",
    "ax = el.drawRadiation(phi=0, radiationType=\"Field\", normalize=True)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "853b2495",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 600x600 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Here, the 'drawRadiation' method is used to generate a 3D directivity plot.\n",
    "ax = el.drawRadiation(radiationType=\"Directivity\", normalize=True, viewAngles=(90,0))\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "00d6bbb3",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 600x600 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Here, the 'drawRadiation' method is used again to generate a 3D directivity plot.\n",
    "# This time, however, we set the angular resolution to 2°, which makes the plot render faster\n",
    "# but slightly coarser than before. (The default angular resolution is 1°.)\n",
    "az = el.drawRadiation(theta=np.arange(0,180.1,2), phi=np.arange(-180,180.1,2), \n",
    "                      radiationType=\"Directivity\", normalize=True, viewAngles=(90,0))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "bb9fb66d",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 600x600 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Create an omnidirectional antenna element with θ(3 dB) = 75°.\n",
    "omni = nr.AntennaElement(beamWidth=[75,360])\n",
    "ax = omni.drawRadiation(radiationType=\"PowerDb\", normalize=True, viewAngles=(40,20))"
   ]
  },
  {
